title: CLAUDE.md Best Practices: The 10-Section Template That Makes Claude Code 10× Better
summary: The CLAUDE.md best practices guide — what to include in each section, how context engineering works, and the template power users actually use in 2026.
body_markdown: Yes. Put a top-level CLAUDE.md with global rules and architecture. Put package-level CLAUDE.md files in each service directory with service-specific context. Claude Code loads the most specific file it finds. For example, when working in` packages/api/` , it loads` packages/api/CLAUDE.md` with the top-level file as additional context.
